coreResponsibility.summary: A Kaltura Player JS plugin that integrates Apple AirPlay functionality for wireless media streaming to AirPlay-compatible devices such as Apple TV.

featureOwnership: AirPlay device detection and availability monitoring
AirPlay UI button component for player controls
Player UI synchronization during AirPlay sessions

stateManaged: Player pause state before AirPlay initiation (wasPaused)
eventsEmitted: airplayavailabilitychanged - Fired when AirPlay device availability changes
airplaystarted - Fired when AirPlay streaming begins
airplayended - Fired when AirPlay streaming ends

repositories.name: kaltura-player-js
repositories.relationship: Peer dependency - provides core player infrastructure, BasePlugin class, UI components system, and event management

browserAPIs: WebKitPlaybackTargetAvailabilityEvent - Safari/WebKit API for AirPlay availability detection
HTMLVideoElement.webkitShowPlaybackTargetPicker() - Native API to show AirPlay device picker
webkitplaybacktargetavailabilitychanged event - AirPlay device availability changes

consumers: Kaltura Player web applications embedding the plugin
Safari browser users on macOS and iOS with AirPlay-compatible devices
uiIntegration: AirPlayButton component injected into BottomBarRightControls container

sourceOfTruth.purpose: Main entry point - exports plugin, events, registers plugin with Kaltura Player
Core AirPlay plugin class - extends BasePlugin, manages AirPlay lifecycle and events
UI component for AirPlay button in player controls
Event type constants for AirPlay state changes

browserCompatibility.primary: Safari (macOS, iOS) - WebKit browsers with AirPlay support
